reviews.title: Tutor Me Section needs improvement .. It keeps glitching on crucial assignments
reviews.text:
I decided to get this app because of the Tutor Me section. When it comes to study apps, I feel like StudyFetch’s biggest advantage is the Tutor Me feature plus its AI integration. Nevertheless, Sparky is having some trouble when it comes to the Tutor Me section, as it keeps repeating previous lessons from different notes instead of responding to what I am currently asking.

Sometimes, rather than replying to me, Sparky starts dictating its coding format and then comes back to tell me that it was having a glitch. Other times, I have to cancel my study session because it’s not responding at all.

I hope the app developers can spend more time fixing the Tutor Me section because, so far, that’s the app’s strongest feature and something you wouldn’t see in many other study apps.

reviews.title: Good customer service, developing app
reviews.text: Customer service was very responsive and helpful, 5/5 on that. The actual app experience was lacking… It would consistently pull outside resources in to “supplement” your material you gave it, even though I directed it not to. Evidently, the LLM forgets everything you tell it each chat (and probably during the session, in my experience) so you can’t actually train it to customize to your learning needs. Also, it randomly started giving me quiz questions in another language…?

reviews.title: AI Clunky and No Active Recall
reviews.text: AI based tools are not very visual or accurate. The diagrams and figures often overwritten or clunky. Additionally, the app prioritizes quizzes, test and AI generated flash cards which do not actually “teach material”. Additionally, the app publicizes the ability to talk to Sparke to work through concepts or if building Lectures; however, I do see that as an option  within my Study Plan and I pay for the premium subscription. As a medical student, I have 2 weeks between exams, I tried this out for about 3/4 days and it has not helped in preparing or saving me time on learning or preparing materials.

reviews.title: Amazing App But Wish It Had Other Features
reviews.text: I personally love this app so much! I used it to help me study for my AP Psych midterm and the actual exam and I scored super well on both. I truly love the ai and how it customizes to your learning style and how you learn. This truly helped improve my studying and made it much more fun as someone with ADHD boring studying can make me forget everything. I also love all the mini apps there are which is fun to try out. That being said I do wish it had some other features! The main one being able to transform your notes, etc, to visuals with illustrations and everything. As I tend to learn well with visual learning and pictures. Another thing is this app seems to be great with more content based subjects but not as much for like math and sciences (though it can depend). So I wish the features did more with generating like problems to work out especially for chemistry, math, physics etc. last thing, I think it would also be great if maybe one day it has like an SAT Prep option or specific AP Prep options (courses). I know that can be hard though. Overall I give this app 5/5 stars because it truly boosted my grades a lot and helped me study much more efficiently!
